title: Governed Bulk Consolidation — CR-006 Root + Verified CR-005/CR-007 Adoption
businessRequirement: Use CR-20260923-006 / bc37709e as the frozen root baseline; preserve all approved UI, workflows, data structures, roles, privacy rules, NVOCC, Global Forwarding, booking, job, documents, finance, payment, release, Operations Control, Action Queue, SLA Automation and Control Tower; selectively re-adopt verified compatible CR-005 Unified Notification Center and CR-007 External Communication functionality; bulk build, integrate, validate and test end-to-end; deploy staging only on PASS; never promote production.
objective: Create one governed current staging baseline that retains CR-006 invariants and incorporates only already-verified compatible CR-005/CR-007 functionality, with full SHARED regression and realistic jobs 50001–50005 business-day UAT.

frozenRootBaseline.rule: Root business/UI/workflow invariants must not regress.

releaseGateBaseline.reason: Latest approved staging registry required by hardened release gate.

CR-20260923-005: Unified internal Operations Notification + Communication Center
Notification preferences with mandatory CRITICAL/LEVEL_3 protection
CR-20260924-007: Provider-ready email state with PENDING_CONFIGURATION when unconfigured

web: Preserve NVOCC and Global Forwarding portals
Adopt CR-007 external communication UI only where existing privacy scope allows
Verify popups, right-side summary/action panels and cross-module links
api: Preserve transactional lifecycle and release/payment security
Adopt verified CR-007 external communication endpoints/privacy/idempotency

acceptanceCriteria: All CR-006 frozen UI/workflow/role/privacy invariants remain intact.
NVOCC and Global Forwarding portals, booking/job/documents/finance/payment/release and Control Tower remain linked end-to-end.
Operations Control, Action Queue and SLA Automation remain operational and auditable.
CR-005 internal notification center remains internal-only and preserves direct remediation links.
CR-007 external communications expose only customer-safe scoped data.
No KYC, internal notes, SLA/control-tower routing, carrier buy rates/credentials, internal finance margin/cost or internal audit assignment data leak externally.
Jobs 50001–50005 complete realistic business-day transaction UAT with zero unreconciled balance.
Duplicate payment/idempotency, document release security, concurrency, provider failure/retry and role/privacy negative tests pass.
No destructive database migration and no secret/credential change.
On PASS deploy staging only, update approved staging registry, freeze new baseline and create acceptance evidence.
On failure auto-rollback staging and do not freeze.
approvedBy: User command: ANCLINE GOVERNED BULK BUILD ALL
notes: Single-command governed bulk execution authorized. Full Web/API/SHARED build, regression, staging-only deploy and freeze on PASS. Production prohibited.
